history.title: Fix B2 as the unified cross-object branch rule (Build A only)
history.proposition: An ASM relative branch whose target lies in a different link object is emitted symbolically when it is rel32 to an exported entry. Otherwise it is emitted with its original literal displacement iff (a) every byte between source and target is supplied in place (ASM pieces of original length or C objects placed in sequence; never legacy layout), (b) a target inside a C object lies within that object's VerifiedRegion, and (c) the final wc1.compare is IDENTICAL. Otherwise the plan is rejected. Each such branch is recorded as Build A placement debt in build output and in a test. Joint TUs (DEC-B06) are preferred when available.
history.evidence: probe P5 (546 fns / 539 files IDENTICAL), probe-b1-b2-groupb.patch sha 1cd77e6c…; RFC §7.2@6f319ac
history.assumptions: in-place layout (existing Build A design).

claude.reason: It unblocks ApplyScenarioTerrainKindRects, UnitFinalizeGone, SelectionClickUnit and MissionDefeat; probe P5 builds IDENTICAL. The debt vanishes in Build B, where neighbours are C.

history.title: Adopt Strict 5-Condition Watcom 10.0a `CONST` Uninitialized Alignment-Gap Rule (Invariant V4)
history.proposition: In both E0 `RegionMatch` and Stage-3 Fix B3, explicitly exempt 1..3-byte alignment padding gaps in `CONST` **if and only if** all 5 conditions hold: (1) segment is `CONST` (never `_DATA`/`_BSS`/`_TEXT`), (2) `1 <= len(gap) <= 3` ending at `align4(gap.start)`, (3) immediately preceded by `0x00` terminating a byte-identical verified literal, (4) zero object fixups and zero `war.exe` fixups/references target any byte in `gap`, and (5) `VerifiedRegion` records `const_pad_exempted = True` and forces `physical_provider = ASM` in Build A.
